title: NPDev Schema Impact Report
description: The read-only impact of an upgrade's schema change against a live database (the GeneXus IAR equivalent), produced by com.finalexec.db.ImpactReport / ImpactReportJson (schema-engine rebuild, Phase 6).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the report was generated.

fingerprintFrom.description: The stored schema fingerprint the live database is currently at, or null if none recorded.

fingerprintTo.description: The desired schema fingerprint of the model being deployed.

acknowledgmentToken.description: Present only when verdict is DESTRUCTIVE: the token an operator must supply to authorize the destructive change.

itemKey.description: Stable identity in the KIND:field:field:... form; destructive items reuse SchemaDeltaItem.stableString() verbatim.

rowsAffected.description: Rows the change touches, from a read-only probe; -1 means the probe could not run (see probeNote).

probeNote.description: Diagnostic for the probe (e.g. MANUAL_REVIEW for a non-character narrowing, or a timeout/failure note).

resolution.description: How this item is expected to be resolved.

proposedConversionSql.description: Phase 8: a proposed conversion SQL statement, or null when none.
